summary: Frontend-only homepage redesign verification completed on public URL after demo login. All requested homepage sections, asset mappings, carousel interactions, product showcase behavior, hash-scroll behavior, and responsive checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Homepage components are well-scoped with data-testid coverage for new interactions (feature cards, product tabs, module controls, technology carousel, counters, progress, and arrows).
No hardcoded endpoint/port usage found in homepage data flow; frontend remains aligned with environment-based backend URL usage.
No critical architecture/code-quality defects observed in modified homepage modules during this test scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://trv-platform-preview.preview.emergentagent.com with demo@trusted-v.com. Confirmed: homepage nonblank/no runtime errors, required sections present, 18 mapped assets route to correct webp slugs, technology carousel has 3/2/1 responsive card counts (1024/768/320), controls + keyboard + swipe + no autoplay work, offscreen slide links are not tabbable, tooling card status and /download-ide destination pass, product module default/software + all tabs/links + prev/next + keyboard pass, hash routes (#virtualization/#certification) land with visible section below fixed header, no overflow at 320/768/1024/1440, and no Developer tab/Developer Experience surfaced in desktop/mobile menus.
rca of the issue: No product defects reproduced in this run. One interrupted automation attempt was due to test-script selector flow (module link checked without activating corresponding tab), not an application issue.
